brief: Counts as Sharpness +2 (+50 max sharpness), Bombardier (blast x1.2, bomb Combinations always succeed), Shot Booster and Speed Sharpening (whetstone in one stroke). Doesn't stack with those skills.

Counts as HG Earplugs (blocks large and small roars), Reload Speed +3, Steady Hand (no bounces, half sharpness loss) and Trap Master (trap Combinations always succeed). Doesn't stack with those skills.
Counts as Guard +2 (guard power -20), Quick Sheath (x1.4 sheathing) and Bladescale Hone (evading with the weapon drawn restores sharpness). Doesn't stack with those skills.

Counts as Critical Eye +3 (+30% affinity) and Challenger +2 (+20 attack, +15% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s), so +45% affinity when enraged. Doesn't stack with those skills.
Counts as Critical Boost (crits x1.4), Bonus Shot, Sharpness +1 and Chance Seizer (Health lost from some hits fills your Arts, Valor and Alchemy gauges). Doesn't stack with those skills.
Counts as Marathon Runner, Bludgeoner, Normal/Rapid Up (x1.1) and Attack Up (M) (+15 attack). An Attack Up (L) source replaces the +15 rather than adding to it.
Counts as Attack Up (L) (+20 attack), Evasion +2 (roll invulnerability 0.2 s to 0.4 s) and Composed (Arts, Alchemy and Valor gauges fill x1.15). Doesn't stack with those skills.
Fortify (attack x1.1/x1.2, defense x1.15/x1.3 after 1/2+ faints), Marathon Runner (Stamina costs and drains halved) and Stamina Thief (exhaust x1.2). No extra Fortify from other sources.
Hits that would bounce land instead, sharpness loss is halved, and Blind Eye's forced bounces are switched off.
Speed Eating +2 (items x1.7, meat x1.8 speed), Meat Lover (Raw Meat usable, Rare and Well-done Steaks stop Stamina drain for 60 seconds) and Mushromancer (mushrooms give item effects) in one.
Bombardier (bomb explosions x1.3, Blast x1.2) plus Trap Master: bomb and trap Combinations always succeed, and five item-placing actions run at double speed.
Your hits build x1.1 stun (KO) and x1.2 exhaust. It only helps attacks that already carry stun or exhaust, such as impact attacks.
Recovery Up (all Health recovery x1.25) plus Divine Blessing (25% chance a hit deals x0.7 damage). It also stops Demonic Blessing from ever triggering.
Load Up (+1 ammo, Bow charge level or Gunlance shell), Combination +20% and Sneak (monsters weigh you x0.8 when choosing a target). It cancels Taunt.
+20 attack (as Attack Up (L)) and +1 sharpness step (as Sharpness +1). Doesn't stack with Attack Up (L) itself.
Normal S, Rapid arrows, Pierce S and Pierce arrows x1.1; Pellet S x1.2 and Spread arrows x1.3. Heavy S and Heavy arrows are not included, and it adds nothing to the single skills it contains.
You can't be poisoned, paralyzed, put to sleep or stunned, and an existing poison does no damage.
Attack x1.3 at 40% Health or less, plus Guts: some hits that would make you faint leave you at 1 Health once, if you had 64 or more. Worrywart has no effect.
One-off Stamina costs such as rolls x0.75, and the roll's invulnerability goes from 0.2 s to 0.33 s. Adds nothing if you already have Evasion +2 and Constitution +2.
Draw attacks deal their stun value and exhaust, +5 attack on Blademaster weapons except the Hammer and Hunting Horn, and sheathing is x1.4 faster on every weapon.
Defense x1.03 then +20 (as Defense Up (M)), and attacks that would lower your Defense do nothing (as Iron Skin).
+20% affinity, plus +50% affinity on hits to weak hitzones (value 45 or more). With 0% weapon affinity, weak-spot hits roll at 70%.
The Great Sword and shield weapons can block attacks that need Guard Up, blocked hits can't lower your Defense, and Stamina recovers x2.
Every evade travels further, and +20 attack while your Health is full (not while Challenger's state is up).
All five elements x1.1 on your weapon, shots and arrows, plus Item Use Up's longer item effects. All element multipliers together are capped at x1.2.
30% chance of an extra charm when you get a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm, and a gathering point is used up less often (5 in 32 per gather instead of 7 in 32).
Great Luck (each extra-reward roll succeeds 28 in 32 instead of 22 in 32) and Capture Expert (every capture gives exactly 3 capture rewards).
Polar Hunter (+15 attack, +20 defence and no Stamina drain in cold areas), Windproof (Hi) (small and large wind pressure negated) and Negate Bind (binds such as Snowman don't take hold).
Negate Poison (Deadly Poison lands only as ordinary poison), Anti-Theft (monsters can't steal your items) and Autotracker (large monsters always shown on the map).
Tropic Hunter (+15 attack, +20 defence and no heat damage in hot areas), Fire Res +20, and Bio Researcher (prevents Stench and Blastblight; Dung Bomb Combinations always succeed).
Adds +2 points to every skill tree you already have points in, so +8 reaches +10. Negative trees rise too (-10 to -8), switching their skill off.
Your talisman's skill points, including its decorations, count twice; negative points double too. Does nothing without a talisman.
Barrel Bomb L explodes like a Barrel Bomb L+ and Bounce Bomb like a Bounce Bomb+, and blast buildup is x1.1 (held to x1.25 total with Bombardier).
Poison, paralysis and sleep build up x1.125 plus a small fixed bonus, on weapons, shots, coatings and thrown items. Shares a x1.25 limit with Status Atk.
Normal S Lv1-3 and the Light Bowgun's charged shots deal x1.1 damage; nothing for Bow arrows. Stacks fully with Normal/Rapid Up for x1.21.
Stones, throwing knives (not the Tranq Knife) and Boomerangs deal x2 damage, and stones, knives, paintballs and some bombs fly 1.5x faster. Dung Bomb combinations always succeed.
Bowgun shots (not Wyvern S) and Bow arrows deal x1.05 damage, but deviation goes up one level and arrows scatter more. Steadiness cancels the deviation level for level.
Your hits build x1.1 stun, covering melee hits, Bow arrows, phials and some bowgun shots. It is the same bonus as Knockout King, so it does nothing with it.
Gunlance shells, Wyvern's Fire and ballista x1.1; Charge Blade phials, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.15. Stacks with Artillery up to each source's limit (x1.3 or x1.4).
Dung Bombs and Dung S hit 1.5 times as hard with their dung effect, and the Dung Bomb combination always succeeds (normally 75%).
Attack x1.35 while your Health is 10 or less (a fixed 10, not a percentage). With Adrenaline +2 it replaces the x1.3 rather than adding to it.
When one of your hits bounces, you lose 1 Sharpness instead of 2. It does not stack with Razor Sharp.
Kicks hit 5 times as hard, though a kick is still a weak attack.
The Shadowbox gesture hits 5 times as hard; it is still very weak, so this is mostly for fun.
Hold the Kick Back gesture for 5 seconds to get +15 Attack for 30 seconds. It shares the timed Attack boost of some consumables, so the last one used replaces the other.
After a bounce, your following hits count x1.1 sharper per bounce in a row, so they bounce less and deal x1.1 raw damage. Other actions reset it.
Sharpening often takes 1 to 3 whetstone strokes instead of 4: about 3.1 seconds on average instead of 4.3. Adds nothing to Speed Sharpening.
+3 Attack and +10 Defense for the first 10 minutes of the quest, counted on the quest timer.
Jumping attacks build mounting x1.125 faster. Stacks with Mounting Master and Airborne up to a x1.4 cap; no help in the struggle once mounted.
Your hits on a monster another hunter is riding fill the rider's struggle gauge x1.2 faster. It never helps your own mounts.
Monsters pay x1.5 as much attention to you, so you are targeted more. Same boost as Taunt and doesn't stack with it.
Healing items restore 10% more Health (Potion 30 to 33), and an Antidote Herb or Bitterbug always cures poison. Stacks with Recovery Up.
Rolls and other one-off moves cost 25% less Stamina, like one extra step of Constitution (half cost is the limit).
Each hit has a 25% chance to deal only 70% of its damage. With Divine Blessing it gets a second try, about 44% in total.
Each hit has a 12.5% (1 in 8) chance to deal only 70% of its damage. With Felyne Defender (Hi) in the meal only Hi counts.
Sprinting drains Stamina half as fast (about 5 per second instead of 10) on any sprint, not only when fleeing large monsters.
You never do the startled flinch when a monster first spots you.
Running while carrying a transport item drains Stamina half as fast, and hits don't knock you back while you carry one. It doesn't slow the normal sprint.
Hits no longer knock you back while you carry a transport item. Adds nothing alongside Felyne Supercat.
Certain evades cost 25% less Stamina, and during some movements hits don't knock you back while you have Health. Includes Felyne Gripper's effect.
During some movements, hits don't knock you back as long as you still have Health. Adds nothing alongside Felyne Cliffhanger.
Hits don't knock you out of carving. Same effect as Carving Pro, so it adds nothing with it or Carving Celebrity.
Protects from harmful ground, not hot or cold areas: no damage from the slower-burning hot ground, no Iceblight from freezing ground, no poison from poison ground.
After getting up from a knockdown you stay untouchable for 0.6 s instead of the normal 0.2 s.
After getting up from a knockdown you stay untouchable for 0.4 s instead of the normal 0.2 s.
You always land normally from any height instead of stumbling, and can act straight away. Works for Prowlers too.
Keeps your meal's extra Health, Attack and other bonuses after a faint for the rest of the quest. Felyne skills stay active after a faint even without it.
Survive one hit that would make you faint, on 1 Health, if you had at least 64 Health. Once per quest; with Guts it is a separate second save.
Defense Down lasts 90 s instead of 3 min and Resistance Down 1 min instead of 2, and each roll shakes off much more of a blight.
Breaking free of a large monster's pin takes about half the presses (2 count where 4 were needed). Works for Prowlers too.
When a monster sends you flying, you recover quickly instead of a long tumble. Being knocked onto your backside is Felyne Feet's job.
Monster attacks can't put you to sleep, like Negate Sleep, but you can't use the base camp bed.
Attacks that would knock you onto your backside only make you flinch. It doesn't stop being sent flying or being grabbed.
When you faint, every teammate in the same area gets 100 Health back. It does nothing for yourself.
One guaranteed extra item in each of your two main quest-reward lists, on top of your normal luck. Replaces Lucky Cat and stacks with the luck skills.
50% chance of one extra item in each of your two main quest-reward lists, rolled separately. Stacks with Good Luck and the other luck skills.
Large monsters can no longer roll tougher than the quest's base health and attack; they come out at base or weaker. Online, anyone in the party having it counts.
You always start in the map's hidden area on quests with random starting points. No effect on Verdant Hills and Jungle.
x1.5 Hunter Rank Points for the quest's main, subquest and bonus rewards. Faint and failure penalties are not multiplied.
Quest reward money x1.5 (50%), x1.75 (30%) or x2.0 (20%), on cleared quests only. Shopkeeping is ignored while you have it.
Shows all large monsters on your map for the first 30 seconds of the quest. Useless with Autotracker.
On unstable quests the extra monster always appears, at the earliest time the quest allows. It doesn't change which monster comes.
Your Palicos get x1.5 experience at the end of the quest.
Both of the quest's later supply deliveries arrive right at the start. Only matters on quests with timed supply deliveries.
You start the quest with 25 health, maximum stamina cut to 25, or both (50% both). With Jinxed Cat too you get both plus 60 seconds of Confusion.
The party's first faint is free: it doesn't count toward the limit, cut reward money or cost Hunter Rank Points. Once per quest; one member having it is enough.
Wycademy Points from the quest x1.5 (50%), x1.75 (30%) or x2.0 (20%), including the smaller main reward of a failed quest.
You start with 60 seconds of Confusion, maximum stamina cut to 25, or both (50% both). Health is not touched.
26% chance of one extra carve on each monster you kill. Does nothing with Carving Celebrity, which already guarantees the extra carve.
13% chance of one extra carve on each monster you kill. Does nothing with Carving Celebrity, which already guarantees the extra carve.
A 1 in 4 chance to save a flute that was about to break, so flutes break a quarter less often. Stacks with the Whim skills and Horn Maestro.
A 1 in 4 chance to save a pickaxe or bug net that was about to break, so they break a quarter less often. Boomerangs aren't affected.
The Veggie Elder always lets you trade 6 times in a row; normally only the first 2 trades are certain.
+20% combination success, added on top of the Combination skills and Felyne Combiner (Lo). The rate can't go over 100%.
+10% combination success, added on top of the Combination skills and Felyne Combiner (Hi). The rate can't go over 100%.
Once a point's guaranteed gathers are used, each gather has a 12.5% chance of being its last instead of 21.9%. Stacks with the Gathering skills.
The fishing gauge fills in 7 steps instead of 10, Sushifish, Burst and Goldenfish Bait catch up to 3 fish instead of 2, and the next fish heads straight for the bait.
